name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, she wasn't really all that tough?」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed, for someone calling herself the Demon King...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this, that makes us completely invincible, doesn't it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I owe you one for introducing me to that part-time job and all, Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, I'll let you off the hook just this once」

name: Macaron
message: 「In exchange, I'm definitely not losing to you next time!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You better not get in my way anymore, Big Brother! Make sure you remember that! Bye-bye!」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder why Macaron-san did something like that...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe Mako-chan is a fake, and the real Demon King is actually pulling the strings behind the scenes?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We can worry about that when the time comes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, even if we don't think too hard about it, things'll work out somehow」

name: Misa
message: 「You're right. Maybe this whole thing is just some kind of mistake.」
Is she really our enemy, I wonder.
Even though she's such a kind, good girl.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm saying I'm hungry, so let's hurry up and go home.」
There's definitely got to be some reason why Macaron called herself the Demon Lord.
Next time we meet, let's try having a proper talk.
Even if she's a Demon, if we truly come to understand each other, we're bound to become friends, right.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, what should I make for dinner tonight~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just gonna be curry like always anyway, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a rude way to put it. Even if it's true.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, wait up for me, Lord Synn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「......Well, if it's important, I'll remember it sooner or later.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Like this, I can't even face Master......」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe, there's no need to thank me」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't let something like this get me down!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I only just arrived in the Human World, so my limits are nowhere near this low!」

name: Macaron
message: 「For the friends I left behind in the Demon World, and for my master who entrusted Alzard to me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm going to become strong as a Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I need to gather allies, too. A king needs charisma, after all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「All right, I'll work hard again starting tomorrow and become a splendid Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no way I'm losing to my big brothers!!」
